remarks: Prime downtown location! Minutes from shopping, transportation, parks and more. This renovated condo in the vibrant Glenbrook neighborhood has an updated kitchen and bathroom. Hardwood floors throughout. Kitchen features quartz countertop, stainless steel appliances and island with room for seating. Spacious living area, sunny and large bedroom with 3 closets! Full tiled bathroom, laundry room next to apartment. Heat, hot water and trash included in Rent.
